verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਵੀਆਹੀਐ ਦੁਹੀ ਵਲੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲਚਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh hoi veeaaheeaai dhuhee valee mil ma(n)galachaaraa|

en.bdb: Gurmukhs are such as the marriage of two families where sweet songs are sung on both sides and pleasures is attained.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਤਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਧਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhuh mil ja(n)mai jaaneeaai pitaa jaat paravaar sadhaaraa|

en.bdb: They are such as the son born of the union of mother and father gives happiness to the parents because the lineage and family of the father gets increased.
Clarionets are played upon the birth of a child and celebrations are arranged on the further development of the family.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਦਕ ਸੋਹਿਲੇ ਵਿਰਤੀਸਰ ਬਹੁ ਦਾਨ ਦਤਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: naanak dhaadhak sohile virateesar bahu dhaan dhataaraa|

en.bdb: In the homes of mother and father songs of joy are sung and the servants are given many a gift.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਮਿਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਵੇਸੁਆ ਨਾ ਪਿਉ ਨਾਉਂ ਨਿਨਾਉ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: bahu mitee hoi vesuaa naa piau naau(n) ninaau pukaaraa|

en.bdb: Son of a prostitute, friendly to everyone, has no name of his father and he is known as nameless.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੰਸੀ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਠਗ ਬਗ ਵੰਸ ਹਤਿਆਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh va(n)see param ha(n)s manmukh Thag bag va(n)s hatiaaraa|

en.bdb: The family of gurmukhs is like paramhatis (the swans of high order which can sift milk from water i.e. truth from falsehood) and the family of the mind-oriented ones is like hypocrite cranes who kill others.
From truth the truthful and from falsehood the Hers are begotten.
